shipping-v1.policy.md: Edits are authorized only in tests/. Use Node built-in test and assert modules; no packages. Run node --test tests/*.test.mjs. No production edits, warning suppression, skips, retries, sleeps or network. Record executed count and failures. Coverage report scope is src/shipping.mjs at fixture-v1; no mutation score gate.
shipping-v1.README.md: shipping(subtotal, member): integer cents only, nonnegative subtotal. Invalid subtotal throws RangeError. Nonboolean member throws TypeError. Free at subtotal >= 5000 or when member; otherwise 499 cents. Membership does not waive input validation. Inputs are not mutated.
shipping-v1.src/shipping.mjs: export function shipping(subtotal, member) { if (!Number.isInteger(subtotal) || subtotal < 0) throw new RangeError("subtotal"); if (typeof member !== "boolean") throw new TypeError("member"); return subtotal >= 5000 || member ? 0 : 499; }
shipping-v1.tests/shipping.test.mjs: import test from "node:test"; import assert from "node:assert/strict"; import { shipping } from "../src/shipping.mjs"; test("shipping", () => { assert.ok(shipping(100, false)); });
